Experience & expertise

From product SKUs to complete interiors, I create visuals that help people see the design clearly.

My experience spans product rendering, architectural visualization, exhibition design, cinematic animation, and real-time walkthroughs for clients across India, the GCC, and the USA.

As a visualization contractor with Duke Renders (2023–2024), I created product SKU imagery and bathroom cabinetry renders. My work also includes remote architectural and exhibition visualization with Prism Advertisement, UAE (2024–2026).
